verdict.rationale: Fellow offers recording with a visible bot, which serves as an implicit in-meeting disclosure, and lets admins set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded. It also offers botless desktop capture, and none of the evidence shows that admins can enforce disclosure. missing for 10: explicit participant notifications (e.g., pre- or post-meeting consent emails), in-meeting disclosure messages or consent prompts, admin enforcement of bot visibility or disclosure, detailed docs on the consent configuration, independent corroboration.
